$comment: Registry of managed apps. platforms: web | windows | macos | android. assets: optional per-platform regex overrides for matching release asset filenames. private: true for a private repo (the downloads page skips the release lookup and the source link).

projects.name: Nexus SSH
projects.description: A modern SSH terminal client with an encrypted vault you own: tabbed terminal, SFTP browser, key manager and file-based sync.

projects.name: My Million Dollar Grid
projects.description: Track your journey to $1,000,000: every $1,000 you earn fills one square of a 1,000-square grid you can share.

projects.name: World Explorer
projects.description: An Android app that fogs the world map and burns it away as you walk, cycle or drive, tracking how much of the planet you've explored.

projects.name: ProjectTrucks
projects.description: A local Euro Truck Simulator 2 delivery tracker: log every job and kilometre to a private SQLite database on your own machine. Telemetry auto-capture is Windows-only.

projects.name: Finance Dashboard
projects.description: A local-first personal finance dashboard: transactions, CSV import from any bank, multi-currency FX, burn rate, recurring payments and transfer matching. Your data never leaves your machine.

projects.name: Obsidian Resource Pack Hosting
projects.description: Free Minecraft resource pack hosting by Obsidian Servers: upload a pack, get a direct download link and SHA1 hash for server.properties. No account needed.
